items.question: Who receives Narayana's grace and rules Sri Bhutapura?
premises: The verse names a recipient of Narayana's grace.
The verse names a lord of Sri Bhutapura.
Both descriptions apply to one figure.
items.inference: The figure described is the recipient of Narayana's grace and lord of Sri Bhutapura.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the figure is not stated in this verse alone.
The compound boundaries are inferred from the fused token.
items.plain_english: Recipient of Narayana's grace, lord of Sri Bhutapura.
